gen-gf-pontano-sans-fs-literata: Literata is a text serif with sturdy thin lines and slightly heavier thick ones, beneath Pontano Sans, whose low-contrast forms look wide-mouthed. Size the body up a notch so its open curves breathe.
gen-gf-prata-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans stays sharp and spacious, set under Prata. Prata brings bookish fat downstrokes and wispy upstrokes, while the sans leaves generous space where its curves meet the stem.
gen-gf-prosto-one-bitter: Dependable and grounded, Bitter is a slab-serif with a very large lowercase eye and an s you can see through. Prosto One towers above it with a wide stride and gentle bowls.
gen-gf-prosto-one-roboto-slab: Roboto Slab is precise and structured, a slab-serif with open throats. Down a full column its dense middle zone sets the texture, while Prosto One strides wide in tall-bodied letters.
gen-gf-pt-sans-narrow-fs-literata: Literata reads bookish and sophisticated, a text serif whose sturdy lines vary gently and curves stay open. And across pages it holds a faint rhythm, a softer foil to the tight, marker-traced lettering of PT Sans Narrow.
gen-gf-rasa-fs-bespoke-sans: Dignified and compact, Rasa pulls gently between heavy verticals and lighter horizontals above the sharp Bespoke Sans. Over lengthy text, the sans stays sharp, leaving space around each curve.
gen-gf-rationale-fs-literata: Folded-paper fans, tucked tight, make Rationale approachable at a glance. Literata follows with sturdy thin lines and slightly heavier thick ones, so paragraph after paragraph feels bookish and unhurried.
gen-gf-red-hat-mono-fs-literata: Precise to the core, Red Hat Mono spaces every glyph generously and bends its c like calipers. Literata adds a middling thick-thin spread and wide curves, giving the monospace lines a bookish counterweight.
gen-gf-red-rose-poppins: Big middles, a clear open e: Red Rose fills the line with real command. Poppins draws a steady drafting-pen line, sans-serif and loose in its curves, with a tall, sturdy lowercase.
gen-gf-sankofa-display-fs-literata: Wire-like and tightly closed, Sankofa Display looks drawn with a single gauge. But Literata does the opposite best, opening its curves wide and letting its weight shift without drama.
